name: freyja-sjonhverfing
description: Freyja Sjónhverfing — depth on a flat plane. A technique layer, not a delivery engine: the depth ladder (L0 layering → L5 real 3D, with the hand-off point to the 3D engine made explicit), CSS 3D space construction (perspective roots, preserve-3d, the flattening property list, backface, hit-testing, text rasterization), anime.js v4 as the value engine (animate / createTimeline / createAnimatable / onScroll / createScope, transform-order trap, v3→v4, three.js adapter boundary), eight recipes, per-engine composition contracts that keep engines 1/2/3/4 independent, and a dependency-free deterministic depth gate (10 judged, 5 explicitly unjudged). Node >= 18 for verification.
